# Transport Degradation on Microwave Link LNK-SUD-02-B Causing Traffic Drop and Latency Spike at S-SUD-001

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-SUD-02-B`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of a major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on the shared microwave link perfectly matches the timing of the traffic drop and latency spike. Changes, maintenance, and external events were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-12 10:30 to 2026-09-12 15:33
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-12 10:31
- **Affected:** S-SUD-001, S-SUD-003, LNK-SUD-02-B

## Summary

A major link degraded alarm occurred on the microwave link serving S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003, causing traffic drops and latency increases.

Traffic volume dropped and latency spiked on sites S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003 between 2026-09-12 10:30 and 2026-09-12 15:33.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-12 10:30: Anomaly ALR-0020 started, showing traffic drops and latency spikes on S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003. [T1, ALR-0020]
- 2026-09-12 10:31: Major alarm ALM-000224 (LINK_DEGRADED) raised on microwave link LNK-SUD-02-B. [T3, ALM-000224]
- 2026-09-12 15:33: Major alarm ALM-000224 cleared on LNK-SUD-02-B, ending the transport degradation impact. [T3, ALM-000224]

## Evidence

- An anomaly detector alert ALR-0020 indicates traffic drops and latency spikes affecting S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003 between 2026-09-12 10:30 and 2026-09-12 15:15. [T1, ALR-0020]
- Topology shows S-SUD-001 and sibling S-SUD-003 both depend on microwave link LNK-SUD-02-B. [T2]
- A major LINK_DEGRADED alarm (ALM-000224) was active on LNK-SUD-02-B from 2026-09-12 10:31 to 2026-09-12 15:33. [T3, ALM-000224]
- No configuration changes or maintenance windows were scheduled during the incident window on the affected nodes or their ancestors. [T4, T5]
- No external events were recorded for the SUD region during the incident window. [T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SUD-02-B: confirmed. The major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on LNK-SUD-02-B directly coincides with the traffic drop and latency spike observed on S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003. [T1, T3, ALM-000224]
2. **bad_change** at S-SUD-001: rejected. No changes were recorded on the affected nodes or their parent chain during the incident window. [T4]
3. **planned_maintenance** at S-SUD-001: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes or their parent chain during the incident window. [T5]

## Ruled out

- T4: No changes were executed on S-SUD-001, S-SUD-003, LNK-SUD-02-B, or AGG-SUD-02 during the window.
- T5: No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-SUD-001, S-SUD-003, LNK-SUD-02-B, or AGG-SUD-02 during the window.
- T7: No external events were reported in region SUD during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect microwave link LNK-SUD-02-B for radio interference, alignment issues, or hardware degradation.
